title: Seat and settings adjustment controls
summary: Feedback in this topic spans seat adjustment, screen-based settings, and other control interfaces, with praise for some adjustment features and criticism of others being hard to find or operate.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise upscale seat-adjustment touches and convenient controllers or touch controls for changing settings.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on seat adjustment placement and screen or switch-based controls being difficult to locate, use, or operate.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews describe seat adjustment nonresponse, blower-control explanations, and screen-setting navigation without enough context to confirm sentiment consistently across examples.

limitations: This topic cluster mixes several related but distinct subjects, including seat adjustment, infotainment or screen-based settings, blower controls, cruise-control adjustment, and rear touch controls.
Some sampled fragments classified as positive or undetermined contain wording that could suggest another sentiment, so the assigned sentiment labels were followed as authoritative.
The examples are limited, so they do not support stronger conclusions about which specific adjustment interface is most important to owners overall.
